words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that “stages › status” is present.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” is at least 0.

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “stages › status” is present; “bid count” is at least 0; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
